newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary milling wheat futures ease in slow market.
newsitem.headline: Hungary milling wheat futures ease in slow market.

text.p: Milling wheat futures eased for most maturities in the grains section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange as turnover remained low, traders said on Monday.
"The selling side for milling wheat was somewhat stronger," said Sandor Ifju of OTP Forex. He added that milling wheat prices were likely to ease further in the next days.
Traders said they expected turnover to pick up in the second half of March on the back of wheat crop estimates and cash-strapped farmers selling their remaining maize stocks.
On Monday March delivery milling wheat rose to 29,010 forints from 29,000. May saw the biggest turnover, of 180 contracts, ending at 27,550, down 350.
Maize futures eased by 10 to 20 forints for March, May and June with March the most active.
"Speculative traders continue to close their March positions as the delivery deadline approaches," Ifju said.
Total turnover of the grains section was an unspectacular 526 contracts or 242.3 million forints, of which 340 contracts were for milling wheat. @
Lot size is 20,000 kgs for all contracts.
